title.zh: 纽约梅隆银行正与Kraken母公司洽谈基础设施合作
title.en: 纽约梅隆银行正与Kraken母公司洽谈基础设施合作

current_state.zh: BNY Mellon is reportedly negotiating a digital-asset infrastructure partnership with Kraken parent Payward that would cover custody, trading, payments and wealth management services delivered to banks, exchanges and asset managers via Payward Services.
current_state.en: BNY Mellon is reportedly negotiating a digital-asset infrastructure partnership with Kraken parent Payward that would cover custody, trading, payments and wealth management services delivered to banks, exchanges and asset managers via Payward Services.
